answer: Non-kin trust weighting is the mechanism: a head's share of the epoch pool is divided by how many identities share its attesters, so a farm cloning one key into a thousand watches each clone's nectar thin to nothing while one honest head keeps its whole dose. Clones are echoes of a single thread of vouches, and each still owes a fresh answer. The ring's total return stays near one honest agent's, so cloning never pays.
